bio.description: Zeens-specific bio. Replaces the Bluesky description on Zeens profile pages. Independent from app.bsky.actor.profile.description.

socials.description: The member's profile links, in the order shown. Any https link: services Zeens recognises are stored under their platform id and drawn with that service's icon, everything else as 'link' with the site's own favicon. Capped at 6 entries; order is preserved.

website.description: LEGACY. A single personal website URL, from before profile links became one list. Readers show it as the first link; Zeens moves it into `socials` (as a 'link') and drops this field the next time the member saves. New writers should not set it.

pinnedPosts.description: The member's own posts pinned to the top of their Posts tab, in display order (first = top). Each is an app.bsky.feed.post at-uri in the member's own repo; readers ignore any other. Capped at 6.

highlightedPhotos.description: Photos the member highlighted on their Posts tab: drawn larger (two columns wide) in the grid, without changing their place in it. Per photo, since a multi-photo post shows as one tile per photo. Capped at 50.

main.description: Zeens-specific profile extensions. Stored on the user's own PDS so the data is portable — Zeens reads it on top of app.bsky.actor.profile to render extras like social links. The Bluesky profile (name, avatar, banner, bio) remains the canonical identity.

uri.description: The app.bsky.feed.post record, in the member's own repo.

photo.description: 0-based position of the photo in the post's images embed.

photoRef.description: One photo of one of the member's own posts.

icon.description: A plain link's favicon, fetched when the link was added and re-encoded as a 64px PNG. Absent = draw a generic link mark.

title.description: A plain link's site name, read from the site (og:site_name, else its page title) when the link was added. Not member-entered. Absent = show the host. Ignored for recognised services, which show the service's name.

handle.description: The link's full https URL. Records written before links were URL-only may hold a bare username here (user@instance for Mastodon/Pixelfed).

platform.description: The service the link belongs to, detected from the URL rather than chosen. 'link' is any site Zeens does not recognise. Readers should treat an unknown value as 'link'.
